description: sudoStream operator dashboard (GET /metrics). Every panel has a human title and description for HTTP, playback, active transcode jobs, HLS cache hit/miss, encoder throttle, DLNA, providers, auth, maintenance, and DB pool.

How many API/UI HTTP requests the server handles each second (excludes /metrics scrapes).

panels.description: How many HTTP requests are being processed right now.
panels.title: Number of HTTP requests in flight

panels.description: How many HLS timeline probe/publish jobs are running right now (building playlists for a title).

panels.description: How many ffmpeg processes are encoding HLS segments right now (includes SIGSTOP-paused sessions that still hold the job).

panels.description: How many Direct Play (or remux progressive) streams are open right now (web + DLNA).

panels.title: HTTP requests per second by route

panels.title: HTTP request latency (p50 / p95 / p99)

Playback & HLS
panels.description: Play-method decisions, progressive streams, timeline/segment jobs, HLS cache, segment serve results, and encoder throttle pause/resume.

panels.title: Playback method decisions
panels.description: How often the server chooses Direct Play, remux, or transcode, by client (web / DLNA).

panels.title: Progressive stream bytes per second
panels.description: Bandwidth served for progressive streams (Direct Play / remux), by client.

panels.title: Player opens by library type
panels.description: How often clients open playback, labeled by library type (film / series / …).

panels.title: Active transcode work over time
panels.description: Live count of HLS timeline jobs and on-demand segment encode sessions.

panels.title: Finished HLS timeline jobs
panels.description: Rate of completed timeline probe/publish jobs by success or error.

panels.title: Finished segment encode jobs
panels.description: Rate of completed ffmpeg segment encode sessions by success or error.

panels.title: HLS timeline job duration
panels.description: How long timeline probe/publish jobs take (p50 and p95).

panels.title: Segment encode duration
panels.description: How long ffmpeg segment encode sessions take (p50 and p95).

panels.title: HLS timeline cache hits and misses
panels.description: Whether a play request reused an existing HLS timeline (hit) or started a new probe job (miss).

panels.title: HLS segment serve results
panels.description: How segment requests were satisfied: cache hit, wait for live encoder, or restart. After E-36, restarts should stay near zero during straight playback (seeks / quality switches / idle reclaim still restart).

panels.title: HLS encoder pause / resume throttle
panels.description: SIGSTOP/SIGCONT pacing for on-demand segment encoders. Pause when ~3 minutes ahead of playback; resume at ~2 minutes. Healthy sequential play shows pause/resume pairs, not segment restarts. Process is killed (not paused) on seek/quality switch, idle reap (45s without segment pulls), encode-to-EOF finish, or service shutdown.

panels.title: ffmpeg errors by stage
panels.description: ffmpeg failures labeled by stage (probe, segment, encode, …).

panels.title: Metadata & media
panels.description: ffprobe indexing, library index size, and poster generation.

panels.title: ffprobe runs by outcome
panels.description: How often metadata scan runs ffprobe, by success or error.

panels.title: ffprobe duration
panels.description: How long ffprobe takes during indexing (p50 and p95).

panels.title: Files indexed per second by library
panels.description: Rate of video files written into the metadata index, by library slug.

panels.title: Number of indexed files by library
panels.description: Current count of indexed media files per library slug.

panels.title: Video poster generations
panels.description: Thumbnail/poster generation attempts by success or error.

panels.title: Auth, DLNA, providers & maintenance
panels.description: Login attempts, DLNA SOAP/streams, provider enricher health, and maintenance cron.

panels.title: Auth login attempts
panels.description: Login outcomes: success, invalid credentials, disabled, 2FA required, invalid TOTP, …

panels.title: DLNA SOAP requests
panels.description: ContentDirectory / ConnectionManager SOAP calls by action and outcome.

panels.title: DLNA stream requests
panels.description: Signed progressive stream attempts from TVs by success or forbidden.

panels.title: Provider HTTP responses by status class
panels.description: Outbound calls to TMDB/TVDB/… grouped by HTTP status class (2xx / 4xx / 5xx).

panels.title: Provider enrichment item outcomes
panels.description: Per-item enricher results (applied, unmatched, errors, …) by provider and task kind.

panels.title: Maintenance runs
panels.description: Finished maintenance actions by name, status, and trigger (cron vs run-now).

panels.title: Maintenance duration (p95) by action
panels.description: 95th-percentile runtime of each maintenance action (scan, providers, trash purge, …).

panels.title: Maintenance in progress by action
panels.description: Gauge per action: 1 while that maintenance task is running, otherwise 0.

panels.title: Process & database pool

panels.description: In-use, idle, and open connections in the database/sql pool.

panels.title: Process memory
panels.description: Resident set size (RSS) and Go heap bytes currently allocated.
